notes.title: Better late than never: Slappyball 1.0 is here
notes.notes:
It's been a wild handful of years, so of course crossing the finish line had to stay spicy. Steam quirks and issues have all been ironed out, so we can finally bring you [b]Slappyball 1.0[/b].

Thank you every single slapper for supporting us!

notes.title: Slappyball Out of Early Access October 29th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for continuing to have fun with Slappyball more than 3 years past the initial early access prototype. We built this game for you and are so happy that so many people have tried it out and enjoyed it.

We’ve been slow on updates recently, and with how tough the games industry is, we’ve had to take on multiple other projects in order to keep going. Slappyball will always be important to us, and our thought is to get it out there in a full 1.0 and see what happens basically.  1.0 doesn’t mean bug free, no game is bug free, but we’re proud of where the game is and sometimes you have to shoot your shot. 

We hope you’ll continue to keep playing for years to come, and here’s a sneak peak at what to expect when [b]SLAPPYBALL VERSION 1.0 LAUNCHES OCTOBER 29TH[/b]!

[b]The nitty gritty:[/b]
We have new Slappyball themed iconic fits for you!
New colors for some existing cosmetics, like Dino and Ghost!
We fixed the issue with player locked camera feeling different at very high or low framerates

[b]New DLC:[/b]
Unlock all early access cosmetics including ALL previous seasons (besides the current active season) for anything you might have missed. If you don’t want to pay, previous seasons do now show up in the shop for you to grind.

Keep slapping y'all.

notes.title: Shorter Casual Matches & Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey, small but medium sized update here:

We felt for awhile that for casual matches, it's length can vary a [i]ton[/i]. And for a cute lil sports game, having a game go on for too long doesn't feel great. Plus, what if you are expecting a shorter game and have important Business to attend to? 

Casual matches are now just one set, 12 points to victory.

As well, there are changes to improve matchmaking reliability and party connections.

Keep on slapping \o/

[b]Small performance update:[/b] frame rate limiting added by default, 30 in menus, 60 in gameplay. Previously it was unlimited, so this should help with GPU usage.

[b]No more lootboxes:[/b] The lootbox has been removed for now, Team Names are given on every level up.

[b]New cosmetic:[/b] Tattoos are added as a new cosmetic option to purchase. More colors and options will be available soon. Right now, you have to pick between wearing a Tattoo or wearing a Jersey, but we are hoping to change that in the next update.

[b]Analytics:[/b] Data to help us make major game design decisions.

[b]Logs:[/b] Steam builds now have logs so that crashes and other errors can be properly diagnosed.

notes.title: Slappyball is under new management
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Slappyball is now being developed by a new team, Amelore. We are a small worker-owned game studio and we are so excited to bring this game to new heights. Here is a quick preview of everything we have in store for y'all:


[b]THE FIRST UPDATE ([i]Est. Later This Week[/i])[/b]

[b]Small performance update:[/b] frame rate limiting! Previously, it was unlimited and we have seen the complaints about high GPU usage even in menus.

[b]No more lootboxes:[/b] The lootbox has been removed for now, Team Names are given on every level up.

[b]New cosmetic:[/b] Tattoos will be added as a new cosmetic option to purchase.

[b]Analytics:[/b] Data to help us make major game design decisions.

[b]Logs:[/b] Phew, let's get some info from those crashes and see how we can fix them.

[i]Leaderboards Fix[/i]: This may not make it into the FIRST UPDATE but if not, we will try to squeeze in a small patch inbetween.

[list]

[/list]

[list]
